Retention

Retention has been measured on a consistent basis across the periods shown. Gross retention excludes expansion; net retention includes expansion, upsell and contraction within the existing base.

Gross revenue retention, FY22: 78.7 percent
Gross revenue retention, FY23: 79.8 percent
Gross revenue retention, FY24: 80.5 percent
Gross revenue retention, FY25: 81.0 percent
Net revenue retention, FY22: 81.0 percent
Net revenue retention, FY23: 83.3 percent
Net revenue retention, FY24: 84.8 percent
Net revenue retention, FY25: 86.2 percent

Gross and net revenue retention, FY22 to FY25.
